question:
Choose the correct meaning of the idiom:

‘Tooth and nail’
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 4**, i.e., "With full strength and determination".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The idiom **"Tooth and nail"** means to fight or struggle with full strength and determination, leaving no effort spared. (पूरी ताकत और दृढ़ता से लड़ना)

 
 
• **Example: **She fought tooth and nail to defend her rights in the courtroom.
 
 
 
• This idiom emphasizes a vigorous and determined effort to achieve or resist something.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Option 1: Secretly and silently** (चुपचाप और गुप्त रूप से)

 
 
• **Example:** The spy carried out the mission secretly and silently without anyone noticing.
 
 
 
• **Option 2: Without any tools** (बिना किसी उपकरण के)
 
 
• **Example:** He tried to fix the broken pipe without any tools, but it was a difficult task.
 
 
 
• **Option 3: In a confused state** (भ्रमित अवस्था में)
 
 
• **Example:** After the sudden announcement, everyone was in a confused state and didn't know what to do.
 
 

14d:T926,

The correct answer is **option 2.**
